title: Stochastic Gradient Descent with Momentum is Algorithmically Stable
abstract: arXiv:2605.28517v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent with momentum (SGDM) is one of the most widely used optimization algorithms in machine learning. While optimization properties of SGDM have been extensively studied in the literature, it remains insufficiently understood whether and when SGDM can generalize well to unseen data. In particular, it has been conjectured that while momentum accelerates training, it may degrade generalization. In this paper, we close this gap by developing a comprehensive generalization analysis of SGDM through the lens of algorithmic stability. More specifically, we introduce a generalized SGDM framework that encompasses both Polyak's and Nesterov's momentum schemes, and establish tight on-average model stability bounds for smooth and convex problems. translated_title: 带动量的随机梯度下降具有算法稳定性
translated_abstract: 带动量的随机梯度下降（SGDM）是机器学习中应用最广泛的优化算法之一。尽管文献中已对SGDM的优化性质进行了广泛研究，但SGDM能否以及何时能够对未见数据进行良好泛化仍知之甚少。特别地，已有猜想认为动量虽然能够加速训练，但可能会损害泛化性能。本文通过算法稳定性的视角对SGDM开展了全面的泛化分析，从而填补了这一空白。更具体地，我们引入了一个广义SGDM框架，该框架同时涵盖了Polyak动量和Nesterov动量两种方案，并针对光滑凸问题建立了紧密的平均模型稳定性界。值得注意的是，所得的稳定性界利用了轨迹上较小的优化误差界，适用于区间 $[0, 1)$ 内的任意动量参数，且无需……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文从算法稳定性角度对带动量的随机梯度下降（涵盖Polyak与Nesterov两种动量方案）进行了全面的泛化分析，为光滑凸问题建立了适用于任意动量参数的紧密平均模型稳定性界，表明动量并不必然损害泛化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a comprehensive generalization analysis of SGDM—covering both Polyak's and Nesterov's momentum schemes—through the lens of algorithmic stability, establishing tight on-average model stability bounds for smooth convex problems that apply to any momentum parameter in $[0, 1)$.
